fact: The National Artificial Intelligence Policy of June 2024 says measures shall encourage government institutions to use AI products and that directives shall be issued listing the AI products and services that may be imported, developed and used and how they are put to use.
title: National Artificial Intelligence Policy / ብሔራዊ የአርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ፖሊሲ
